title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions change when it is trained on different datasets. High variance models are sensitive to the specific data they are trained on.

title: Effect of Feature Transformation
text: Transforming features can help reduce model variance by simplifying the model or making it less sensitive to fluctuations in the data.

title: Consider Polynomial Features
text: Adding polynomial features can increase model complexity, which might increase variance. Consider transformations that simplify the model instead.
